about: Bodies, status questions and machinery-of-government events that ANA (Anatomy of Government, a govukOS app being retired) held and this register does not. Nothing here is in the register yet. Each entry keeps ANA's own wording as its origin and lists the official source to read. A maintainer reads that source before any entry is added, then sets the status to 'added' and records the register id. Sources marked read_by Cadastre were read from the official directories on 4 October 2026 by another govukOS app; they are a pointer, not a reading by this register.
licence: Facts come from the sources named on each entry, under each source's own terms (Open Government Licence v3.0 for GOV.UK, gov.scot and gov.wales; Open Parliament Licence for UK Parliament pages). Notes are by this register, CC BY 4.0.
origin: ANA source file version 1794096244-f8f9; ANA fold register rows D073 (bodies) and V049 (what is new)
